description: This PHP source file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao class, which is responsible for data access operations related to employee US tax exemptions within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It provides methods to save an employee's tax exemption data and retrieve it by employee number.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDao
classes.description: Data access object (DAO) class for managing employee US tax exemption records in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Persists an EmpUsTaxExemption entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpUsTaxExemption entity based on the employee number, or null if not found.
